name: session-memory
description: Four slash commands for session continuity across agent sessions: /primer orients a cold start and reports drift between the memory file and the repo, /LoadMemory resumes warm, /BackupMemory writes the durable handoff, /handoff-doc compacts the conversation itself for a fresh agent. The first three share one contract — a SESSION_MEMORY.md whose mandatory Next Session Kickoff section the readers quote by name — so a lost handoff is reported rather than silently inherited. Repo-agnostic: source layout, CI workflow, and tracker are discovered at runtime. Composes with (and works fully without) Matt Pocock's optional handoff skill, reading its rules rather than forking them.
